This is the strongest direct positive macro indicator for a “stronger trajectory” reading.","question_ids":["5B.10"]},{"title":"RBI said growth was strong but inflation was still sticky because of food shocks and external volatility","publisher":"Reserve Bank of India","date":"8 Aug 2024","url":"https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=58448","summary":"The RBI explicitly described India’s growth as strong and inflation as broadly declining, but it also stressed stubborn food inflation, climate/geo-political risks, and global fragmentation. This supports the idea that Modi inherited real external constraints, even as macro conditions improved.","question_ids":["5B.10"]},{"title":"Pre-election budget resisted giveaways and stayed fiscally tight","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"1 Feb 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/economy/india-refrains-from-populist-budget-before-election-trims-fiscal-deficit/1948823/","summary":"Reuters reported that the government resisted large pre-election spending and kept the fiscal-consolidation path, with subsidies down and major tax policies unchanged. That is evidence of longer-horizon macro management rather than short-term vote buying.","question_ids":["5B.10"]},{"title":"Post-election budget preserved fiscal discipline while shifting spending toward jobs, rural demand, and infrastructure","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"23 Jul 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/india-budget-shifts-spending-priorities-while-keeping-fiscal-deficit-in-check/2187377/","summary":"The budget cut the deficit target to 4.9% of GDP, kept record infrastructure capex, and redirected funds toward jobs and rural programs. This is the best evidence that Modi’s government left office on a firmer fiscal/investment path than a simple short-term populist cycle.","question_ids":["5B.10"]},{"title":"Ratings agencies upgraded outlooks or affirmed ratings on growth and fiscal credibility","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"29 Aug 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/economy/moodys-raises-indias-growth-forecasts-fitch-affirms-rating/2243897/","summary":"Moody’s raised growth forecasts and Fitch affirmed India’s rating, citing broad-based growth, easing inflation expectations, and continued infrastructure thrust. The same report also notes fiscal weakness and that coalition politics may limit deeper reforms, which tempers the positive reading.","question_ids":["5B.10"]},{"title":"Voter reaction showed the growth model was not yet broad-based enough","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"7 Jun 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/rural-vote-fall-cost-indias-modi-a-decisive-election-win/2121496/","summary":"Reuters reported that Modi’s party lost a third of its rural constituencies because of lack of jobs and high inflation. This is strong counterevidence to any claim that the economy had clearly improved for ordinary households by 2024.","question_ids":["5B.10"]},{"title":"Election surveys said unemployment, inflation, and falling income weakened Modi’s support","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"6 Jun 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/modis-appeal-clouded-in-india-election-by-prices-jobs-graft-survey-says/2119215/","summary":"The survey-based reporting ties BJP’s weaker result to jobs, prices, and falling incomes. That undercuts the argument that inherited economic conditions had clearly improved in the lived experience of voters.","question_ids":["5B.10"]},{"title":"RBI’s 2024 stance shows macro stabilization, but not a full solution to food inflation","publisher":"Reserve Bank of India","date":"8 Aug 2024","url":"https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=58448","summary":"The RBI kept rates unchanged and said disinflation needed to continue.
